description:
[Admin]

Creates an empty folder (creating one that exists is fine), renames a folder, or deletes an empty one. Renaming moves every file in the folder: each gets a new address, the old address keeps working for published pages, and page drafts move to the new one. Files still uploading stay where they are. A folder name has 1 to 60 characters: letters, digits, spaces, "-", "_", ".", "(" and ")"; it cannot start with ".", "_" or a space, end with a space, or be "profile".

action.description: `create` an empty folder, `rename` one with every file in it, or `delete` an empty one.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

folder.description: The folder to create, rename or delete.

merchant_id.description: Optional company. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's company.

to.description: The new name. Required to rename.

name: Create_rename_or_delete_a_media_library_folder

drafts_updated.description: Rename only: page drafts moved to the new addresses. Published pages keep the old ones until they are published again.

folder.description: The folder as it is now: the new name after a rename.

moved.description: Rename only: files moved to the new folder.

warnings.description: Rename only: things worth telling the person. The folder was renamed.

title: Media Folders
